name: fbones_get_project
description: Read the live authored project, stable IDs, revision, supported-profile flags and Undo/Redo state.

name: fbones_capture_viewport
description: Capture the actual editor viewport as a PNG image with current camera and pose metadata, after visible resources load. Requires active AI control and matching project revision/documentId. This shows the CURRENT editor view, not a separately requested evaluation frame.

name: fbones_create_project
description: Create a new binary project in the live editor. Explicit discardChanges is required to discard a dirty document.

name: fbones_close_project
description: Close the live project; dirty replacement is rejected unless discardChanges is true.

name: fbones_open_project
description: Open an existing local binary .fbones or .spine project. Unsupported records remain inspection-only.

name: fbones_save_project
description: Save using native revision-checked binary encoding. Use a local .fbones target; never overwrite .spine originals.

name: fbones_export_runtime
description: Export the supported authored runtime data and referenced assets to a local directory.

name: fbones_edit
description: Apply ONE native history action. Covers bones, slots, attachment inventory, mesh topology, weights/Auto, clipping, IK/Transform/Physics, all supported animation keys/events/sequences, Undo and Redo. Use returned stable IDs/revision. For evaluated world-space edits supply the exact frozen poseEpoch.

name: fbones_evaluate_project
description: Sample transient animation/constraint/Physics poses without baking Setup data. Times are seconds; key authoring frames use animationFps. Returned poseEpoch freezes world interpretation for edits.

name: fbones_import_image
description: Import a local PNG through native resource validation in one history action.

name: fbones_import_psd
description: Import a local supported flat raster PSD preserving layer positions/stacking through native resource validation in one history action.

name: fbones_choose_images_folder
description: Use a local resource folder without opening an OS picker. Native portable-path/resource safety rules apply.

name: fbones_choose_audio_folder
description: Use a local resource folder without opening an OS picker. Native portable-path/resource safety rules apply.

name: fbones_refresh_images_folder
description: Refresh image inventory from the current resource directory.

name: fbones_place_image
description: Place a library image with its center at Setup world x/y, attached to the supplied stable bone ID. Native resource/history handling applies.

name: fbones_place_images
description: Place a library image batch with its first center at world x/y and remaining images on a grid, in one native history action. Optional frozen poseEpoch uses evaluated world coordinates.

name: fbones_place_attachments
description: Add library images as alternative attachments to an existing slot.

name: fbones_get_image_data
description: Read a validated cached project PNG by its resource key and documentId.

name: fbones_get_audio_data
description: Read a validated cached project audio resource by its key and documentId.

name: fbones_preview_trace
description: Preview bounded alpha/inner-detail auto trace for a slot. Preserve expectedRevision and poseEpoch from preview through apply. Apply is one native history action.

name: fbones_apply_trace
description: Apply bounded alpha/inner-detail auto trace for a slot. Preserve expectedRevision and poseEpoch from preview through apply. Apply is one native history action.

name: fbones_preview_trace_attachment
description: Preview bounded alpha/inner-detail auto trace for an attachment. Preserve expectedRevision and poseEpoch from preview through apply. Apply is one native history action.

name: fbones_apply_trace_attachment
description: Apply bounded alpha/inner-detail auto trace for an attachment. Preserve expectedRevision and poseEpoch from preview through apply. Apply is one native history action.
